items.english: Do not clear site data to fix a waiting save. It can remove downloads and unsent work. Keep the device protected and resolve the save message first.
items.draft: Moenie terreindata uitvee om 'n wagtende stoor reg te maak nie. Dit kan aflaaie en ongestuurde werk verwyder. Hou die toestel beskerm en los eers die stoorboodskap op.
items.backtranslation: Do not delete site data to fix a waiting save. It can remove downloads and unsent work. Keep the device protected and resolve the save message first.
items.problem: "Site data" here is the browser's stored website data, but "terreindata" reads as data about the farm site, so a farmer would not realise that clearing browser data is what can wipe downloads and unsent work.
items.corrected: Moenie webwerfdata in jou blaaier uitvee om 'n wagtende stoor reg te maak nie. Dit kan aflaaie en ongestuurde werk verwyder. Hou die toestel beskerm en los eers die stoorboodskap op.

items.english: Record edible unopened heads by planting batch; do not use open-flower months as picking months.
items.draft: Teken eetbare ongeopende koppe volgens plantgroep aan; moenie maande van oop blomme as plukmaande gebruik nie.
items.backtranslation: Record edible unopened heads by plant group; do not use months of open flowers as picking months.
items.problem: "Planting batch" (one sowing/planting) became "plantgroep" (plant group), so a farmer may group records by kind of plant instead of by each planting.
items.corrected: Teken eetbare ongeopende koppe volgens aanplanting aan; moenie maande van oop blomme as plukmaande gebruik nie.

items.english:
Place A01-A04 beneath their own crop headings. A05 is one hire bill for R120.00. The equipment record shows two hours for carrots and four for the second crop: carrots receive 2/6 of the bill, the second crop 4/6. Together the shares must still equal the one bill. A06 is a separate R90.00 market trip. Its agreed practice basis is occupied equal-size crate spaces, two for carrots and one for the other crop. Explain why this bill uses a different record.

There is no universal rule that hours or crate spaces always give the fairest allocation. Ask what caused the shared cost and whether the record describes it. The chosen basis must fit the decision and period. If the usage record is missing, show an unallocated amount and investigate. Do not quietly assign it all to the crop that looks most profitable.
items.draft:
Plaas A01-A04 onder hul eie gewasopskrifte. A05 is een huurrekening vir R120.00. Die toerustingrekord wys twee uur vir wortels en vier vir die tweede gewas: wortels kry 2/6 van die rekening, die tweede gewas 4/6. Saam moet die dele steeds gelyk wees aan die een rekening. A06 is 'n afsonderlike markrit van R90.00. Die ooreengekome oefenbasis daarvan is bestekte kratspasies van gelyke grootte, twee vir wortels en een vir die ander gewas. Verduidelik waarom hierdie rekening 'n ander rekord gebruik.

Daar is geen universele reël dat ure of kratspasies altyd die regverdigste toedeling gee nie. Vra wat die gedeelde koste veroorsaak het en of die rekord dit beskryf. Die gekose basis moet by die besluit en tydperk pas. As die gebruiksrekord ontbreek, wys 'n ontoegedeelde bedrag en ondersoek dit. Moenie dit stilweg alles toeken aan die gewas wat die winsgewendste lyk nie.
items.backtranslation:
Place A01-A04 under their own crop headings. A05 is one hire bill for R120.00. The equipment record shows two hours for carrots and four for the second crop: carrots get 2/6 of the bill, the second crop 4/6. Together the shares must still equal the one bill. A06 is a separate market trip of R90.00. Its agreed practice basis is booked crate spaces of equal size, two for carrots and one for the other crop. Explain why this bill uses a different record.

There is no universal rule that hours or crate spaces always give the fairest allocation. Ask what caused the shared cost and whether the record describes it. The chosen basis must fit the decision and period. If the usage record is missing, show an unallocated amount and investigate it. Do not silently assign it all to the crop that looks the most profitable.
items.problem: "bestekte" is not a recognisable Afrikaans word for "occupied", so the agreed basis for splitting the R90.00 trip cost is unclear (it may be read as "booked").

items.english: The app saves edits as you work. Read the header. If it says NOT saved or reports full storage, retain a copy and resolve the warning before leaving. Saved confirms the device save; it does not by itself prove the same version has reached another device.
items.draft: Die app stoor wysigings terwyl jy werk. Lees die opskrif. As dit NIE gestoor nie sê of vol berging aandui, hou 'n kopie en los die waarskuwing op voordat jy weggaan. Gestoor bevestig die stoor op die toestel; dit bewys nie op sy eie dat dieselfde weergawe 'n ander toestel bereik het nie.
items.backtranslation: The app saves edits while you work. Read the heading. If it says NOT saved or indicates full storage, keep a copy and resolve the warning before you leave. Saved confirms the save on the device; it does not on its own prove that the same version reached another device.
items.problem: The word order "As dit NIE gestoor nie sê" is hard to parse, so a farmer may not recognise the NOT saved warning that tells them to keep a copy before leaving.
items.corrected: Die app stoor wysigings terwyl jy werk. Lees die opskrif. As dit “NIE gestoor nie” sê of aandui dat die berging vol is, hou 'n kopie en los die waarskuwing op voordat jy weggaan. Gestoor bevestig die stoor op die toestel; dit bewys nie op sy eie dat dieselfde weergawe 'n ander toestel bereik het nie.

items.english:
Discuss four cards:

1. “The app printed a VAT number, so this is a valid tax invoice.” **Not established.** A field or title alone does not establish registration, supply treatment or all required particulars. Inspect the document with the applicable current guidance.
2. “I did not need to submit a return, so no records are needed.” **Not established.** Do not infer all record duties from that fact. Ask about the applicable requirements and any continuing audit, dispute or other obligation.
3. “My export is a complete set of accounts and guarantees a loan.” **Not established.** Check it against the other evidence. An export does not establish completeness, creditworthiness or approval.
4. “A missing stock value should be zero.” **Incorrect.** Request the count, valuation and reconciliation. Do not disguise missing information as a measured result.
items.draft:
Bespreek vier kaarte:

1. “Die app het 'n BTW-nommer gedruk, so dit is 'n geldige belastingfaktuur.” **Nie bewys nie.** 'n Veld of titel alleen bewys nie registrasie, die hantering van die lewering of al die vereiste besonderhede nie. Ondersoek die dokument met die toepaslike huidige riglyne.
2. “Ek hoef nie 'n opgawe in te dien nie, so geen rekords is nodig nie.” **Nie bewys nie.** Moenie al die rekordpligte uit daardie feit aflei nie. Vra oor die toepaslike vereistes en enige voortgesette oudit-, geskil- of ander verpligting.
3. “My uitvoer is 'n volledige stel rekeninge en waarborg 'n lening.” **Nie bewys nie.** Kontroleer dit teen die ander bewyse. 'n Uitvoer bewys nie volledigheid, kredietwaardigheid of goedkeuring nie.
4. “'n Ontbrekende voorraadwaarde moet nul wees.” **Verkeerd.** Vra vir die telling, waardasie en rekonsiliasie. Moenie ontbrekende inligting as 'n gemete resultaat vermom nie.
items.backtranslation:
Discuss four cards:

1. "The app printed a VAT number, so it is a valid tax invoice." **Not proven.** A field or title alone does not prove registration, the handling of the supply or all the required details. Investigate the document with the applicable current guidelines.
2. "I do not need to submit a return, so no records are needed." **Not proven.** Do not infer all the record duties from that fact. Ask about the applicable requirements and any continuing audit, dispute or other obligation.
3. "My export is a complete set of accounts and guarantees a loan." **Not proven.** Check it against the other evidence. An export does not prove completeness, creditworthiness or approval.
4. "A missing stock value must be zero." **Wrong.** Ask for the count, valuation and reconciliation. Do not disguise missing information as a measured result.
items.problem: The English card is past tense ("I did not need to submit a return"); the draft makes it present tense, shifting the record-keeping claim from a past filing period to now.

items.english: Use the [expense guide](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/expenses) for supported actual cost entries and receipt evidence. Keep the comparison, deposit schedule and asset/share record separately. The app's cost tag is not a complete asset register, depreciation calculation or tool-booking system. Do not enter every proposed offer as an actual expense or create an invented produce sale for a deposit refund.
items.draft: Gebruik die [uitgawegids](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/expenses) vir ondersteunde inskrywings van werklike koste en kwitansiebewyse. Hou die vergelyking, depositoskedule en bate-/aandeelrekord afsonderlik. Die app se kosteteken is nie 'n volledige bateregister, waardeverminderingsberekening of besprekingstelsel vir gereedskap nie. Moenie elke voorgestelde aanbod as 'n werklike uitgawe invoer of 'n versinde produkverkoping vir 'n depositoterugbetaling skep nie.
items.backtranslation: Use the [expense guide](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/expenses) for supported entries of real costs and receipt evidence. Keep the comparison, deposit schedule and asset/share record separate. The app's cost record is not a complete asset register, depreciation calculation or booking system for tools. Do not enter every proposed offer as a real expense or create an invented produce sale for a deposit refund.
items.problem: "kosteteken" (cost sign/mark) does not clearly mean the app's cost tag, so a farmer may not know which app feature is being said not to be an asset register.
items.corrected: Gebruik die [uitgawegids](https://imbewufield.vercel.app/student/guides/expenses) vir ondersteunde inskrywings van werklike koste en kwitansiebewyse. Hou die vergelyking, depositoskedule en bate-/aandeelrekord afsonderlik. Die app se koste-etiket is nie 'n volledige bateregister, waardeverminderingsberekening of besprekingstelsel vir gereedskap nie. Moenie elke voorgestelde aanbod as 'n werklike uitgawe invoer of 'n versinde produkverkoping vir 'n depositoterugbetaling skep nie.
